appTagline: Your Hot Wheels collection, safe and synced.
brandHeadline:
Your collection,
in the right place.
brandDescription: Register, organize and track every model in your Hot Wheels collection with security and ease.
featureCloud: Photos and data synced to the cloud
welcomeBackSubtitle: Sign in to access your collection.
createAccountSubtitle: Start organizing your collection in seconds.
forgotPasswordSubtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
resetEmailSent: If an account exists for this email, a password reset link has been sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.
firebaseNotConfiguredBody: Open js/firebase-config.js and paste the Web app configuration from your Firebase project. The README explains every step.
firebaseNotConfiguredStep1: Create a Web app in the Firebase console.
setupReadmeHint: See appphp/README.md for the full setup and deployment guide.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
languageSubtitle: Choose the language of the interface.
dataProtectedSubtitle: Authentication and storage provided by Firebase.
themeModeSubtitle: Choose light, dark or follow the system.

followSystemOnSubtitle: The app follows the system appearance.
followSystemOffSubtitle: Turn on to use the system appearance.
garageReady: Your garage is ready for its first model.
carsInGarageZero: No cars in your garage yet
searchHint: Search by name, description or collection...

informationSubtitle: Details that help identify and showcase your model.
